branch.name: Developer Platform
branch.summary: Software development tooling: GitHub and GitLab repos, issues, pull/merge requests and CI pipelines; Jira and Linear tickets; Sentry errors; CircleCI builds.

toolkits.name: GitHub
toolkits.summary: Official GitHub MCP server: repositories, files, code search, issues, pull requests and GitHub Actions workflow runs.

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create a new issue in a GitHub repository.

assignees.description: Usernames to assign to this issue

labels.description: Labels to apply to this issue

type.description: Type of this issue (org-level issue types, see list_issue_types)

tools.name: list_issues
tools.description: List issues in a GitHub repository. For pagination, use the 'endCursor' from the previous response's 'pageInfo' in the 'after' parameter.

state.description: Filter by state, by default both open and closed issues are returned when not provided

orderBy.description: Order issues by field. If provided, the 'direction' also needs to be provided.

direction.description: Order direction. If provided, the 'orderBy' also needs to be provided.

perPage.description: Results per page for pagination (min 1, max 100)

after.description: Cursor for pagination. Use the endCursor from the previous page's PageInfo for GraphQL APIs.

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Get details of a specific issue in a GitHub repository.

tools.name: update_issue
tools.description: Update an existing issue in a GitHub repository.

state_reason.description: Reason for the state change. Ignored unless state is changed.

duplicate_of.description: Issue number that this issue is a duplicate of. Only used when state_reason is 'duplicate'.

tools.name: add_issue_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a specific issue in a GitHub repository. Use this tool to add comments to pull requests as well (in this case pass pull request number as issue_number), but only if user is not asking specifically to add review comments.

tools.name: search_issues
tools.description: Search for issues in GitHub repositories using issues search syntax already scoped to is:issue

query.description: Search query using GitHub issues search syntax

owner.description: Optional repository owner. If provided with repo, only issues for this repository are listed.

repo.description: Optional repository name. If provided with owner, only issues for this repository are listed.

sort.description: Sort field by number of matches of categories, defaults to best match

perPage.description: Results per page for pagination (min 1, max 100)

tools.name: list_pull_requests
tools.description: List pull requests in a GitHub repository. If the user specifies an author, then DO NOT use this tool and use the search_pull_requests tool instead.

head.description: Filter by head user/org and branch

perPage.description: Results per page for pagination (min 1, max 100)

tools.name: get_pull_request
tools.description: Get details of a specific pull request in a GitHub repository.

tools.name: create_pull_request
tools.description: Create a new pull request in a GitHub repository.

tools.name: merge_pull_request
tools.description: Merge a pull request in a GitHub repository.

tools.name: get_file_contents
tools.description: Get the contents of a file or directory from a GitHub repository

path.description: Path to file/directory (directories must end with a slash '/')

ref.description: Accepts optional git refs such as `refs/tags/{tag}`, `refs/heads/{branch}` or `refs/pull/{pr_number}/head`

sha.description: Accepts optional commit SHA. If specified, it will be used instead of ref

tools.name: search_code
tools.description: Fast and precise code search across ALL GitHub repositories using GitHub's native search engine. Best for finding exact symbols, functions, classes, or specific code patterns.

query.description: Search query using GitHub's powerful code search syntax. Examples: 'content:Skill language:Java org:github', 'NOT is:archived language:Python OR language:go', 'repo:github/github-mcp-server'. Supports exact matching, language filters, path filters, and more.

perPage.description: Results per page for pagination (min 1, max 100)

tools.name: list_workflow_runs
tools.description: List workflow runs for a specific workflow

workflow_id.description: The workflow ID or workflow file name

actor.description: Returns someone's workflow runs. Use the login for the user who created the workflow run.

branch.description: Returns workflow runs associated with a branch. Use the name of the branch.

event.description: Returns workflow runs for a specific event type

status.description: Returns workflow runs with the check run status

perPage.description: Results per page for pagination (min 1, max 100)

tools.name: get_job_logs
tools.description: Download logs for a specific workflow job or efficiently get all failed job logs for a workflow run

job_id.description: The unique identifier of the workflow job (required for single job logs)

run_id.description: Workflow run ID (required when using failed_only)

failed_only.description: When true, gets logs for all failed jobs in run_id

return_content.description: Returns actual log content instead of URLs

tail_lines.description: Number of lines to return from the end of the log

tools.name: rerun_failed_jobs
tools.description: Re-run only the failed jobs in a workflow run

run_id.description: The unique identifier of the workflow run

toolkits.name: GitLab
toolkits.summary: GitLab projects: issues, merge requests and diffs, CI/CD pipelines and job logs.

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create a new issue in a GitLab project

project_id.description: Project ID or URL-encoded path, e.g. 1834 or group%2Fproject

assignee_ids.description: Array of user IDs to assign

confidential.description: Set the issue to be confidential

tools.name: list_issues

project_id.description: Project ID or URL-encoded path, e.g. 1834 or group%2Fproject

state.description: Return issues with a specific state

assignee_username.description: Return issues assigned to the given username

author_username.description: Return issues created by the given username

scope.description: Return issues from a specific scope

tools.name: list_merge_requests
tools.description: List merge requests in a GitLab project with filtering options

project_id.description: Project ID or URL-encoded path, e.g. 1834 or group%2Fproject

state.description: Return merge requests with a specific state

author_username.description: Returns merge requests created by the given username

reviewer_username.description: Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer

tools.name: create_merge_request
tools.description: Create a new merge request in a GitLab project

project_id.description: Project ID or URL-encoded path, e.g. 1834 or group%2Fproject

tools.name: get_merge_request_diffs
tools.description: Get the changes/diffs of a merge request (Either mergeRequestIid or branchName must be provided)

project_id.description: Project ID or URL-encoded path, e.g. 1834 or group%2Fproject

merge_request_iid.description: The IID of a merge request

tools.name: list_pipelines
tools.description: List pipelines in a GitLab project with filtering options

project_id.description: Project ID or URL-encoded path, e.g. 1834 or group%2Fproject

username.description: The username of the user who triggered pipelines

updated_after.description: Return pipelines updated after the specified date

updated_before.description: Return pipelines updated before the specified date

tools.name: get_pipeline_job_output
tools.description: Get the output/trace of a GitLab pipeline job with optional pagination to limit context window usage

project_id.description: Project ID or URL-encoded path, e.g. 1834 or group%2Fproject

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return from the end of the log

offset.description: Number of lines to skip from the end of the log

tools.name: retry_pipeline
tools.description: Retry a pipeline

project_id.description: Project ID or URL-encoded path, e.g. 1834 or group%2Fproject

toolkits.name: Jira
toolkits.summary: Atlassian Jira Cloud/Server: JQL search, issue details, create/update issues, workflow transitions and comments.

tools.name: search_issues
tools.description: Search Jira issues using JQL (Jira Query Language).

jql.description: JQL query string. Examples: 'project = PROJ AND status = "In Progress"', 'assignee = currentUser() AND sprint in openSprints()', 'updated >= -7d ORDER BY priority DESC'

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return in the results. Use '*all' for all fields.

projects_filter.description: Comma-separated list of project keys to filter results by.

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Get details of a specific Jira issue including its Epic links and relationship information.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return, or '*all'.

comment_limit.description: Maximum number of comments to include (0 for none)

update_history.description: Whether to update the issue view history for the requesting user

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create a new Jira issue with optional Epic link or parent for subtasks.

project_key.description: The JIRA project key (e.g. 'PROJ', 'DEV'). This is the prefix of issue keys in your project.

issue_type.description: Issue type (e.g. 'Task', 'Bug', 'Story', 'Epic', 'Subtask'). The available types depend on your project.

assignee.description: Assignee's user identifier (email, display name, or account ID)

components.description: Comma-separated list of component names to assign

parent.description: Parent issue key, required for subtasks

epic_link.description: Epic issue key to link to

additional_fields.description: Additional fields to set, including custom fields (customfield_10010 etc.).

tools.name: update_issue
tools.description: Update an existing Jira issue including changing status, adding Epic links, updating fields, etc.

additional_fields.description: Optional additional fields to update, including custom fields.

attachments.description: Comma-separated list of file paths to attach

tools.name: transition_issue
tools.description: Transition a Jira issue to a new status.

transition_id.description: ID of the transition to perform. Use get_issue with expand=transitions to find available transitions.

fields.description: Fields to update during the transition, e.g. resolution.

comment.description: Comment to add during the transition

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a Jira issue.

toolkits.name: Sentry
toolkits.summary: Sentry application monitoring: error issues, events and counts, issue triage (resolve/ignore/assign) and releases.

tools.name: search_issues
tools.description: Search for grouped issues/problems in Sentry - returns a LIST of issues, NOT counts or aggregations. Uses AI to translate natural language queries into Sentry issue search syntax. Use this for: 'show me issues', 'list problems', 'what errors need attention', 'unresolved issues from the last day'. Do NOT use for counts ('how many errors') - use search_events instead.

organizationSlug.description: The organization's slug. You can find a existing list of organizations you have access to using the `find_organizations()` tool.

naturalLanguageQuery.description: Natural language description of issues to search for

projectSlugOrId.description: The project's slug or numeric ID (optional)

regionUrl.description: The region URL for the organization you're querying, if known. For Sentry's Cloud Service (sentry.io), this is typically the region-specific URL like 'https://us.sentry.io'.

limit.description: Maximum number of issues to return

includeExplanation.description: Include explanation of how the query was translated

tools.name: get_issue_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Sentry issue by ID. USE THIS TOOL WHEN USERS: provide a specific issue ID (e.g. 'CLOUDFLARE-MCP-41', 'PROJECT-123'); ask to 'explain' or 'show details' of an issue; want the stacktrace or error details; reference a Sentry issue URL. DO NOT USE for general searching or listing issues (use search_issues) or for counting/aggregations (use search_events). Returns the latest event with its full stacktrace, tags, context, first/last seen timestamps and occurrence counts. Provide either issueUrl, or organizationSlug together with issueId.

organizationSlug.description: The organization's slug. You can find a existing list of organizations you have access to using the `find_organizations()` tool.

eventId.description: The ID of a specific event to look up instead of the latest.

issueUrl.description: The URL of the issue. e.g. https://my-organization.sentry.io/issues/PROJECT-1Z43

regionUrl.description: The region URL for the organization you're querying, if known. For Sentry's Cloud Service (sentry.io), this is typically the region-specific URL like 'https://us.sentry.io'.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search for events AND perform counts/aggregations - the ONLY tool for statistics and counts. Supports error events, spans/traces and logs. Translates natural language into Sentry's query syntax. Use for: 'how many errors today', 'count of 500s by endpoint', 'slowest transactions', 'logs mentioning timeout'.

organizationSlug.description: The organization's slug. You can find a existing list of organizations you have access to using the `find_organizations()` tool.

naturalLanguageQuery.description: Natural language description of what you want to search for

dataset.description: Dataset to query; inferred when omitted.

regionUrl.description: The region URL for the organization you're querying, if known. For Sentry's Cloud Service (sentry.io), this is typically the region-specific URL like 'https://us.sentry.io'.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

tools.name: update_issue
tools.description: Update an issue's status or assignment in Sentry. This allows you to resolve, ignore, or reassign issues.

organizationSlug.description: The organization's slug. You can find a existing list of organizations you have access to using the `find_organizations()` tool.

status.description: The new status for the issue

assignedTo.description: The assignee in format 'user:ID' or 'team:ID' where ID is numeric.

regionUrl.description: The region URL for the organization you're querying, if known. For Sentry's Cloud Service (sentry.io), this is typically the region-specific URL like 'https://us.sentry.io'.

tools.name: find_releases
tools.description: Find releases in Sentry.

organizationSlug.description: The organization's slug. You can find a existing list of organizations you have access to using the `find_organizations()` tool.

projectSlug.description: The project's slug. Leave empty to search all projects.

query.description: Search for versions which contain the provided string.

regionUrl.description: The region URL for the organization you're querying, if known. For Sentry's Cloud Service (sentry.io), this is typically the region-specific URL like 'https://us.sentry.io'.

toolkits.name: CircleCI
toolkits.summary: CircleCI pipelines: latest pipeline status, failure logs, test results, flaky test detection and workflow reruns.

tools.name: get_build_failure_logs
tools.description: This tool helps debug CircleCI build failures by retrieving failure logs. CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS: 1. Truncation Handling (HIGHEST PRIORITY): ALWAYS check for <MCPTruncationWarning> in the output; when present, you MUST start your response by telling the user the output was truncated. Input options (EXACTLY ONE of these THREE options must be used): Option 1 - Project Slug and branch (BOTH required); Option 2 - Direct URL (a CircleCI pipeline, workflow or job URL); Option 3 - Project Detection (BOTH workspaceRoot and gitRemoteURL are required, plus branch). Returns the failed steps with their log output, job names and links to the failing jobs.

projectSlug.description: The project slug from listFollowedProjects tool (e.g., "gh/organization/project")

branch.description: The name of the branch currently checked out in local workspace. Only needed with projectSlug.

projectURL.description: The URL of the CircleCI project. Can be a project URL, pipeline URL, workflow URL or job URL.

workspaceRoot.description: The absolute path to the root directory of your project workspace.

gitRemoteURL.description: The URL of the remote git repository. Used together with workspaceRoot to infer the project.

tools.name: find_flaky_tests
tools.description: This tool retrieves information about flaky tests in a CircleCI project. The agent receiving this output MUST analyze the flaky test data and implement appropriate fixes based on the specific issues identified.

projectSlug.description: The project slug from listFollowedProjects tool (e.g., "gh/organization/project")

projectURL.description: The URL of the CircleCI project. Can be a project URL, pipeline URL, workflow URL or job URL.

workspaceRoot.description: The absolute path to the root directory of your project workspace.

gitRemoteURL.description: The URL of the remote git repository. Used together with workspaceRoot to infer the project.

tools.name: get_latest_pipeline_status
tools.description: This tool retrieves the status of the latest pipeline for a CircleCI project. It can be used to check pipeline status, get latest build status, or view current pipeline state.

projectSlug.description: The project slug from listFollowedProjects tool (e.g., "gh/organization/project")

branch.description: The name of the branch currently checked out in local workspace. Only needed with projectSlug.

projectURL.description: The URL of the CircleCI project. Can be a project URL, pipeline URL, workflow URL or job URL.

workspaceRoot.description: The absolute path to the root directory of your project workspace.

gitRemoteURL.description: The URL of the remote git repository. Used together with workspaceRoot to infer the project.

tools.name: get_job_test_results
tools.description: This tool retrieves test metadata for a CircleCI job. It can be used to get test results for a job, check which tests are failing, or view test execution details.

projectSlug.description: The project slug from listFollowedProjects tool (e.g., "gh/organization/project")

branch.description: The name of the branch currently checked out in local workspace. Only needed with projectSlug.

projectURL.description: The URL of the CircleCI project. Can be a project URL, pipeline URL, workflow URL or job URL.

workspaceRoot.description: The absolute path to the root directory of your project workspace.

gitRemoteURL.description: The URL of the remote git repository. Used together with workspaceRoot to infer the project.

tools.name: rerun_workflow
tools.description: This tool is used to rerun a workflow from start or from the failed job.

workflowId.description: The ID of the workflow to rerun

fromFailed.description: If true, reruns the workflow from failed jobs. If false, reruns the workflow from the start.

workflowURL.description: The URL of the CircleCI workflow or job.
